theory Factor
  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

(* If m^2 = 1 (mod n) with n > 1, then n does not divide m - 1 unless m = 1 (mod n). *)
lemma shor_gcd_ne_one:
  fixes m n :: nat
  assumes n: "1 < n" and mm: "(m * m) mod n = 1" and m1: "m mod n \<noteq> n - 1"
  shows "gcd (m - 1) n \<noteq> 1"
proof
  have m0: "m \<noteq> 0" using mm by auto
  have e1: "(m - 1) * (m + 1) + 1 = m * m"
    using m0 by (cases m) (auto simp: algebra_simps)
  have dm: "n * (m * m div n) + 1 = m * m"
    using div_mult_mod_eq[of "m * m" n] mm by auto
  have prod: "(m - 1) * (m + 1) = n * (m * m div n)"
    using e1 dm by linarith
  have dv: "n dvd (m - 1) * (m + 1)"
    using prod by simp
  assume g1: "gcd (m - 1) n = 1"
  have cop: "coprime n (m - 1)"
    using g1 by (simp add: coprime_iff_gcd_eq_1 gcd.commute)
  have dvn: "n dvd (m + 1)"
    using coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff[OF cop] dv by blast
  then obtain t where ht: "m + 1 = n * t" by (auto elim!: dvdE)
  have h2: "(m mod n + 1) mod n = 0"
    using ht by (simp add: mod_add_eq[symmetric])
  have r0: "m mod n < n" using n by simp
  have h3: "m mod n + 1 = n"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "m mod n + 1 \<noteq> n"
    then have "m mod n + 1 < n" using r0 by linarith
    then have "(m mod n + 1) mod n = m mod n + 1" by simp
    with h2 show False by simp
  qed
  show False using h3 m1 n by linarith
qed

(* If n divides m - 1 and m is nonzero, then m mod n = 1. *)
lemma shor_one_mod:
  fixes m n :: nat
  assumes n: "1 < n" and m0: "m \<noteq> 0" and dv: "n dvd (m - 1)"
  shows "m mod n = 1"
proof -
  obtain s where hs: "m - 1 = n * s" using dv by (auto elim!: dvdE)
  have ms: "m = n * s + 1" using hs m0 by (cases m) auto
  have "m mod n = (1 + s * n) mod n" using ms by (simp add: mult.commute add.commute)
  also have "\<dots> = 1 mod n" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = 1" using n by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

theorem shor_factor:
  assumes n: "1 < n" and ord: "is_order n a r" and even: "even r"
    and not_minus_one: "a ^ (r div 2) mod n \<noteq> n - 1"
  shows "1 < gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n \<and> gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n < n"
proof -
  obtain k where hk: "r = 2 * k" using even by (auto elim: evenE)
  have hkk: "r = k + k" using hk by arith
  have hkd: "r div 2 = k" using hk by arith
  have rpos: "0 < r" using ord unfolding is_order_def by blast
  have k0: "0 < k" using rpos hkk by arith
  have kr: "k < r" using k0 hkk by arith
  have ord1: "a ^ r mod n = 1" using ord unfolding is_order_def by blast
  have ord2: "a ^ k mod n \<noteq> 1"
    using ord kr k0 unfolding is_order_def by blast
  have pw: "a ^ r = a ^ k * a ^ k" by (simp add: hkk power_add)
  have mm: "(a ^ k * a ^ k) mod n = 1" using ord1 pw by simp
  have nm1: "a ^ k mod n \<noteq> n - 1" using not_minus_one hkd by simp
  have g_ne1: "gcd (a ^ k - 1) n \<noteq> 1"
    using shor_gcd_ne_one[OF n mm nm1] by simp
  have m0: "a ^ k \<noteq> 0" using mm by auto
  have dvd_nm: "\<not> n dvd (a ^ k - 1)"
  proof
    assume dv: "n dvd (a ^ k - 1)"
    have "a ^ k mod n = 1" using shor_one_mod[OF n m0 dv] .
    with ord2 show False by simp
  qed
  have gpos: "gcd (a ^ k - 1) n \<noteq> 0" using n by simp
  have gle: "gcd (a ^ k - 1) n \<le> n"
    using dvd_imp_le[OF gcd_dvd2[of "a ^ k - 1" n]] n by simp
  have gneq: "gcd (a ^ k - 1) n \<noteq> n"
  proof
    assume "gcd (a ^ k - 1) n = n"
    then have "n dvd (a ^ k - 1)" using gcd_dvd1[of "a ^ k - 1" n] by simp
    with dvd_nm show False by simp
  qed
  have goal': "1 < gcd (a ^ k - 1) n \<and> gcd (a ^ k - 1) n < n"
    using g_ne1 gpos gle gneq by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal' hkd by simp
qed

end

lemma shor_gcd_ne_one:
  fixes m n :: nat
  assumes n: "1 < n" and mm: "(m * m) mod n = 1" and m1: "m mod n \\<noteq> n - 1"
  shows "gcd (m - 1) n \\<noteq> 1"
proof
  have m0: "m \\<noteq> 0"
  proof
    assume "m = 0"
    then have "(m * m) mod n = 0" by simp
    with mm show False by simp
  qed
  have e1: "(m - 1) * (m + 1) + 1 = m * m"
    using m0 by (cases m) (auto simp: algebra_simps)
  have dm0: "m * m div n * n + 1 = m * m"
    using div_mult_mod_eq[of "m * m" n] mm by simp
  have prod: "(m - 1) * (m + 1) = m * m div n * n"
    using e1 dm0 by linarith
  have dv: "n dvd (m - 1) * (m + 1)"
    unfolding prod by simp
  assume g1: "gcd (m - 1) n = 1"
  have cop: "coprime n (m - 1)"
    using g1 by (simp add: coprime_iff_gcd_eq_1 gcd.commute)
  have dvn: "n dvd (m + 1)"
    using coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff[OF cop] dv by blast
  then obtain t where ht: "m + 1 = n * t" by (auto elim!: dvdE)
  have h2a: "(m + 1) mod n = 0"
    by (subst ht) simp
  have h2: "(m mod n + 1) mod n = 0"
  proof -
    have "(m mod n + 1) mod n = (m + 1) mod n" by (rule mod_add_left_eq)
    also have "\\<dots> = 0" by (rule h2a)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have r0: "m mod n < n" using n by simp
  have h3: "m mod n + 1 = n"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume ne: "m mod n + 1 \\<noteq> n"
    then have lt: "m mod n + 1 < n" using r0 by linarith
    have "(m mod n + 1) mod n = m mod n + 1" by (rule mod_less[OF lt])
    with h2 show False by simp
  qed
  have "m mod n = n - 1" using h3 by arith
  with m1 show False by simp
qed
